legal_definition: A transport vehicle or omnibus whose gross vehicle weight, or a motor car/tractor/road-roller whose unladen weight, does not exceed 7,500 kg.
weight_range: <=7500 kg (GVW or unladen, per vehicle type)

legal_definition: Any goods carriage other than a light motor vehicle or a heavy goods vehicle.
Any goods carriage the gross vehicle weight of which, or a tractor/road-roller the unladen weight of either of which, exceeds 12,000 kg.
Any public service vehicle, private service vehicle, or educational institution bus, other than a motor cycle, adapted vehicle, light motor vehicle or heavy passenger motor vehicle.
weight_range: residual band between LMV and HPMV thresholds

legal_definition: A public service vehicle, private service vehicle or educational institution bus whose gross vehicle weight exceeds 12,000 kg.
A motor vehicle constructed or adapted to carry not more than six passengers, excluding the driver, for hire or reward.
A motor vehicle constructed or adapted to carry more than six but not more than twelve passengers, excluding the driver, for hire or reward.
A motor vehicle constructed or adapted to carry more than six persons, excluding the driver, not falling within the definition of a motorcab or maxicab.

A motor vehicle (other than a transport vehicle, omnibus, road-roller, tractor or side-carriage attached to a motor cycle) meant primarily for carrying persons, with an unladen weight not exceeding a prescribed limit.
A two-wheeled motor vehicle, of any power, not fitted with a gear mechanism (includes mopeds/scooters below the prescribed engine capacity).
A two-wheeled motor vehicle fitted with a gear-shifting mechanism.

A motor vehicle specially designed and constructed, and not merely adapted, for the use of a person suffering from some physical defect or disability, and used solely by or for such a person, with an unladen weight not exceeding 300 kg.
A motor vehicle adapted for use by a person with a disability, as inserted by the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2019.
A motor vehicle to which a semi-trailer is attached.
A motor vehicle which is not itself constructed to carry any load (other than equipment used for the purpose of propulsion), and is primarily designed to haul or propel an implement or trailer.
Any vehicle, other than a semi-trailer and a side-car, drawn or intended to be drawn by a motor vehicle.
licence_class_required: requires TRANS endorsement on towing vehicle licence

legal_definition: A motor vehicle with any three wheels, constructed or adapted for carrying passengers or goods for hire or reward.
A three-wheeled motor vehicle used for private, non-hire purposes.
A special purpose battery-powered vehicle of power not exceeding 4,000 watts, having three wheels, for carrying passengers, for hire or reward.
licence_class_required: E-RICKSHAW (separate licence category under Rule 2A CMVR)

legal_definition: A special purpose battery-powered vehicle of power not exceeding 4,000 watts, having three wheels, for carrying goods, for hire or reward.
licence_class_required: E-CART (separate licence category under Rule 2A CMVR)

legal_definition: A four-wheeled motor vehicle meeting a prescribed lightweight specification, distinct from a motor car, used for passenger or light goods carriage.
weight_range: below prescribed lightweight threshold (exact figures NOT_VERIFIED)

legal_definition: A motor vehicle which carries passengers for hire or reward under a contract for the use of the vehicle as a whole, at a fixed or agreed rate, without stopping to pick up passengers not included in the contract.
A motor vehicle carrying passengers for hire or reward at separate fares paid by or for individual passengers, either for the whole journey or for stages of the journey.

A motor vehicle used for the carriage of persons for or in connection with the trade or business of the vehicle owner, other than for hire or reward (e.g. staff transport), and not being a stage or contract carriage.
A public or private service vehicle used solely for conveying students or staff of a recognised educational institution.
Any motor vehicle constructed or adapted for carriage of goods, or any motor vehicle not so constructed or adapted when used for the carriage of goods solely or in addition to passengers.
A heavy self-propelled vehicle used for compacting road surfaces, classified by weight as light, medium or heavy for licensing purposes.

A specified category of self-propelled, rubber-tyred or steel-drum-wheeled construction machinery (e.g. excavator-loader, wheel loader, dozer, mobile crane) as defined under the Central Motor Vehicles Rules.
A motor vehicle specially fitted out for the conveyance of sick or injured persons, treated as a special-purpose passenger vehicle under CMVR body-type classifications.
A trailer drawn by a motor vehicle in such a manner that a substantial part of its weight is borne by the drawing vehicle, used in articulated goods vehicle combinations.
